issues.where: ListStackPress.tsx header block (top bar div ~L118-121, title block ~L122-125); frames 0,6,14,30
issues.problem: The rebuilt page chrome (brand bar, title, subtitle, meta rule) uses left/right:215 and padding 0 215px, i.e. a 1920-wide page, but the card column and the original header only span the card width (original header rule runs exactly over the card column, about 1090 px wide at final zoom). Persian header is far wider than the cards (right edge ~1762-1845 vs card right edge ~1500-1570). It is misaligned with the stack, and at frame 0 (camera zoom 1.35) the brand 'آزمایشگاه بنیاد هوش مصنوعی' and the title are cropped off the right edge of the frame ('ایشگاه', '..های پژوهش'), while the first beats of the original show everything fully inside the frame.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the header block to the card column (use cards[0].x and cards[0].w from layout.json: left=c.x, width=c.w) and mirror inside that column, so brand, title and meta rule start and end on the card edges. Re-check frame 0 and 6 so nothing is cropped.

issues.problem: Text overlap in the subtitle area: the 16px subtitle 'مقاله‌های تازه در یادگیری ماشین و هوش مصنوعی' collides with the meta line 'امروز · ۵ مقالهٔ تازه' (they sit on top of each other because the meta row is absolutely positioned at top:70 inside a 62px block with the larger Persian line-heights). At frame 14 the subtitle also shows broken clipped letters at its left end. The 'به‌روزرسانی روزانه' label also sits at x~227 right next to the counter's 'رادار مقاله' at frame 30, cluttering the counter.
issues.suggestedFix: Use FA_LH line-heights for the title block, push the meta row down (top ~86-90), and raise the 62px block height. Keep the left update label clear of the screen-space counter at 96-240 px, e.g. by aligning to the card column.

issues.problem: The counter starts at the Persian zero, which renders as a small ring/dot (a bullseye) at 96px, not as a recognisable numeral. It also overlaps the page header bar in frames 0-14 and reads as a stray bullet. The original shows a clear '0'. During rolls the tall digits are also cut mid-glyph in a very visible way.
issues.suggestedFix: Show the zero with a real zero glyph that reads at that size (e.g. render ۰ larger/with a different weight or a fitting family for the digits, or draw a Latin-style 0 inside a ltr island), or style the first strip cell so the initial state is clearly '۰'. Verify frames 0-12 specifically.

issues.problem: The arXiv-style identifier uses the Persian decimal separator '٫' and Persian digits, but it is an ID (original 'arXiv:2607.01001'), not a number. The '#1 ↑ 63' becomes '۱ · ۶۳ رأی' which loses the ranking/upvote semantics, and 'رأی' is inconsistent with the common 'رای' spelling.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep the ID as an LTR island (<bdi dir=ltr>2607.01001</bdi>) with a period, and use «رای». Optionally use '#۱' style rank.

issues.problem: The highlight is placed over the 'note' line and, while growing, hides most of the text beneath it, same as the original, but it sits at right:20 with width up to 40% anchored to the right edge, while the colored tag (the linked-project name, ~72% height) is now on a different line than in the original, so the bar overlaps the note line rather than the project name. A faint vertical leftover line is still visible on the last card at the final frame 87.
issues.suggestedFix: Position the bar from the measured tag row (tag line top) rather than c.h*0.72, so it covers the project name as the source prompt describes; make sure hlFade reaches 0 before the last frame or clamp the border opacity.

issues.problem: The header comment is short and does not list every decision (ring-zero digits, why slots are rebuilt, header width choice, highlight side, the dropped 'loaded all' footer, the dropped filter button and TL;DR line). It claims the page 'remains centered' but the rebuilt header is not aligned with the centered card column.
issues.suggestedFix: Expand the header comment with each element, the direction decision and the reason, and the raster handling.

issues.problem: Fidelity gaps vs the original: the original page showed a filter button, a date/summary line, TL;DR rows, arXiv/HuggingFace row and a footer ('已全部加载' / all loaded); the Persian page drops the filter button and the footer, so the page is sparser at the first beats and the end frame. Motion is otherwise faithful: CUES, DUR, FLY_EASE, TILTS, camera keys, stackPress, glaze timings and the exported LIST_STACK_PRESS_DURATION=88 are unchanged. Glaze mirrored correctly (right anchor, -14deg, 270deg gradient), counter mirrored to the top-left, highlight side mirrored.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a filter chip (فیلتر) at the title row start side and a footer line «همهٔ مقاله‌ها بارگذاری شد».

notes: Motion code and timing are intact and the direction decisions on glaze, counter and highlight are sound. Persian shaping inside cards is good (no letter-spacing, joins intact, Vazirmatn loaded, no leftover Chinese/English, no raster text left since DOM rebuild). The problem is composition: the rebuilt header/title block does not match the card column width, is cropped at frame 0, has overlapping text lines, and the counter's initial Persian zero renders as a ring over the header. These are visible in the first 20 frames, and the video should not ship until they are fixed. No cheating (blur/hide) found: text is genuinely rebuilt.
